frankLines: You filed every attachment... again? I am suspicious of your competence now.
Marcus prepared the report. That does not make him the only person involved in the operation.
Alex Murphy handled its equipment records. Storage room. You have probably met him and survived the manual.
Ask him about McClane's transport. Then come back if his memory develops a security classification.
alexLines: McClane? That is not an equipment request.
Yes, I handled equipment records. No, I am not discussing a restricted operation because you found some paper.
Bring me an authorized account of that transport, not an archaeological reconstruction of the waste bin.
The archive has the redacted copy and its attachments. If you have a question, establish what the paperwork actually says first.

messages.referred: Lead recorded: ask Alex Murphy in the storage room about John's transport.
messages.refused: Alex will not discuss the operation. Return to the archive and reconstruct the redacted report.
messages.decoded: Report reconstructed. Keep it for the later confrontation with Alex.
